claim: Run long checks in the harness's own background mode with no time limit: setsid nohup jobs die with the tool call, and a background command given a limit is stopped at it.

evidence.text: setsid nohup jobs died with the tool call; the harness's own background mode worked.
A background command given a time limit is stopped at the limit.
A cheat test passed the shell's time limit at load 60; run long tests in the background.
Five full runs in parallel take about 25 minutes; auto prints nothing until it ends.
Full verify takes about 80 minutes detached.
On a heavily loaded machine a long shell command sat unstarted; replaced by separate short ones.
